content.text: This clause set sits at or above the preferred position.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals with a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice, plus a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal and an extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent — the reminder-failure extension is more protective than the playbook baseline. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. Renewal term length, notice window (30 days) and price cap (3%) all meet the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
